Chapter I — Methodological Foundation & Atlas Hygiene

Reproducing `scMagnify` & Harmonizing the Multi-Cohort Lung Continuum

We privately forked LiHongCSBLab/scMagnify onto branch scelixir-repro, resolved 13 numerical, initialization, memory, and plotting defects (including zero-bias final-layer init, repressor sign preservation, L1-normalized lags $\tau \in [1, 5]$, `decoupler` MLM/ULM collinearity guards, and NumPy interval coverage in `GenomeViewer`), and reproduced Chen et al. (2026) on human CD34+ hematopoiesis and E15.5 mouse pancreas . Prior multi-cohort harmonization audits proved why `quadbio CSS` (`Age–DPT ρ = 0.896`, `0.03%` stage leakage) and `Hybrid CSS+Harmony` must replace `BBKNN`, which caused catastrophic `40.86%` embryonic↔adult stage leakage .

Chapter II — Scientific Question 1

Within Each Developmental Timepoint: Long-Lag Master Regulators vs Static SCENIC+ Transients

Within each developmental window (T1–T4), zero-bias scMagnify with context-active gating separates multi-step chromatin pioneers ($\tau \ge 2.65$) from rapid signaling effectors ($\tau < 2.65$) , while `RegFactor` tensor decomposition and lead-lag curves isolate mitotic bursts (`E2F1`), dissociation spikes (`EGR1/FOS/JUN`), and static `SCENIC+` off-lineage artifacts (`WT1` `889` targets, non-DBD `TOB2`, zero-motif `ZNF813`) . In adult nuclear `T4`, fetal pioneers `SOX9, HMGA2, MYCN` and proximal `SOX2` drop cleanly to `0` active targets .

Methodological Note: Non-linear epistasis (`Dexamethasone / NR3C1` antagonism or multi-factor cooperativity) cannot be predicted by summing single-factor `LSO-Ridge` scores; prospective organoid Controls 1–3 are mandatory.

Phase I (Days 0–2): Single-LV + LNP Unlock

Transduce single bicistronic Tet-On SOX9-P2A-HMGA2 (`MOI <= 2`, Dox-On), deliver transient LNP-siRNA CEBPA + CEBPD (`25 nM`), and withdraw Dexamethasone (`NR3C1` silent) .

Phase II (Days 2–5): Replication-Coupled Priming

Maintain FGF10 (50 ng/mL) + CHIR99021 (3 µM) + RepSox (1 µM) (drives endogenous ETV5) + Days 1–3 50 nM Decitabine or catalytic GSK3484862.

Phase III (Days 5–17): Dox-Off & Clonal Split

Washout Dox at Day 5 (`SOX9-P2A-HMGA2` silent), verify against Control 1 (niche-media empty-vector), and run Controls 2 & 3 (`+DCI` rescue & single-cell clonal `AT2 + AT1` split) .
